atoms.text: Florian and Elda are both monsters at the Monster Academy. Florian is learning how to throw pottery, while Elda learns how to recite monster poetry.
Both Florian and Elda are in PE together. They like playing monster games. Elda is very good at Monster Tag, but Florian is the best at Capture the Monster Flag.
